title: corydalis racemosa
intro: Corydalis racemosa, commonly known as Western poppy or yellow fumewort, is a flowering plant in the poppy family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, pain relief, and sedation. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis racemosa are attributed to its ability to inhibit the reuptake of neurotransmitters such as serotonin and norepinephrine, which can help to regulate mood and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of Corydalis racemosa include alkaloids, phenanthrene, and other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic properties.
